1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.g3 Bc5 4.Bg2.strategy: Completes the fianchetto: the bishop backs up e4 and the whole centre from a safe corner, and is ready for the long diagonal once the position opens. White is solid and keeps a flexible plan.

1.e4 e5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.g3 Bc5 4.Bg2 h5.strategy: An offbeat attempt to attack the fianchetto with the h-pawn. It gains space on the wing but loosens Black's own kingside before the king has castled, so it gives White time.
